name: Document - Approval Workflow

parameters.query: UPDATE doc_documents SET status = 'PENDING_APPROVAL', submitted_at = NOW() WHERE id = $1 AND tenant_id = $2 AND status = 'DRAFT' RETURNING title, category, doc_type, author_id;
SELECT u.mattermost_user_id FROM doc_approvers da JOIN users u ON u.id = da.user_id WHERE da.tenant_id = $1 AND da.doc_type = $2 LIMIT 1;
